purpose: Context-localized microclimate and soil advisories for smallholder farmers across rural Maharashtra

data_sources.source: Farmer-submitted crop and soil health observations via mobile app
data_sources.provenance: Direct voluntary submission by registered agrarian cooperatives

labor_conditions.annotation_wages: Living wage (25% above local district minimum wage)
labor_conditions.working_hours: 7.5 hours/day, 5 days/week with mandatory rest breaks

compute_carbon.hardware_reuse_policy: Refurbished edge-compute devices with 5-year lifecycle guarantee

affected_communities.impact_type: Agronomic decision support and drought resilience
affected_communities.redress_mechanism: Gram Panchayat grievance desk with guaranteed 7-day human appeal review

ahimsa_commitment: Constructive programme application: System explicitly engineered to protect smallholder farmer livelihoods from predatory speculative middlemen, ensure data sovereignty (swaraj), and maintain community-led redress.
